outcome: Page-wide watchers no longer do work on every simulation update (about 10 times less main-thread work during runs)
owner_impact: Nothing changes on screen. Three pieces of code watch the whole page so they can react when panels, dialogs and controls appear (the collection organizer, the accessibility layer and the workspace shell). Because they watched everything, every number the simulation updated woke all three, about 4,500 times in 10 seconds of running, costing about half a second of the page's main thread. They now ignore updates that are only text or attribute changes inside the simulation section, and still react to everything else. Measured over 10 seconds of running: about 50 ms instead of about 520 ms. Before making the change I checked, on the current version, that in 4,370 such updates these watchers never changed anything on the page. Test now: optional. Run a simulation and open the account, library and collection dialogs; everything should work as before and may feel lighter while running.

next.text: #569 continues: stop building and updating the hidden duplicate old views where nothing reads them any more, starting with the simulation labels, one panel at a time. Nothing changes on screen.

technical_evidence: New web/src/live-region.js: onlyLiveRuntimeUpdates(records) is true when every record is a text or attribute change inside #simulation. Element insertions and removals there, and any change elsewhere, still count.
collection-organization.js, workspace-shell.js and ux-hardening.js skip such batches in their document.body observers.

Safety proof on the production build: 4,370 noise-only batches during run, add plot, pause, restart, new seed and run; the observers' reactions changed the document in 0 of them (full outerHTML compared before and after); 45 structural batches still handled.
Measured over 10 s runs (instrumented observers, two runs each): 508 to 526 ms before, 48 to 50 ms after; same simulated time.

Full-page A/B, production versus this build: simulation 18/18, results 11/11, editor 16/16, extended apply scenarios 28/28 identical. New live-region.test.mjs (4 tests); 687 tests pass. Style comparison identical at all four viewports.
